title: Lucky Thirteen Menthols Blue Widow 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Lucky Thirteen’s Blue Widow is an exquisitely complex flavour that dares to blend the iconic vape juice taste of Blue Raspberry with dash of Aniseed spice and a lash of invigorating Ice. This beguiling blend demonstrates Lucky Thirteen’s uncanny talent for novel flavour blends and provides a giddy thrill for vapers who love deliciously complex flavour combos. This product contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to let you tailor your e juice’s nicotine content. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mod vapes and sub-ohm tanks , producing rich clouds and immaculate flavour.
